_about: Labels for the browser-diagnose message in inject-browser-refs.js. Key: the first 8 hex digits of the Claude account id in the Claude app log (acct:<id>, and Connecting to bridge .../chrome/<id>). account = the Claude account's email; profile = the Comet profile whose Claude extension is signed in to it. Evidence, 2026-10-21: at 16:55 the app was on c68119fc and paired with the new extension (device c6de10fa) in the profile Erez named info@muuula.com; Erez reported the original profile's extension shows erez@muuula.com, and that extension (device fc836352) paired on a47791bc links on 10-20 and 10-21. Labels go stale if Erez signs an extension in to a different account; to re-check, compare the log's account id at a successful pairing with the account each profile's Claude extension shows.
